name: checks-panel
title: Checks panel
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A checks count pill that opens lint, typecheck, unit, preview, and e2e rows. Closed by default.

examples.title: Panel de comprobaciones

api.name: passed / total / sha / message
api.description: The pill and the panel header.

api.name: checks
api.description: queued, running, passed, failed, skipped, or cancelled. progress is 0 to 1.

api.name: labels
api.description: English by default. checksPanelLabelsEs is es-MX.

docs: Clean-room. Idea only, no license (Phil Pitus, Generative UI #6). The panel stays closed until opened. Each row has an icon, a status word, a bar, and a time. If estimated is set, the row says the time is estimated. The bar uses scaleX, not the host Progress primitive, because that primitive animates with transition-all. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive. No theme. Motion is opacity and transform, and it stops when reduced motion is preferred.
